newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway Jan CPI seen up 0.15 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway Jan CPI seen up 0.15 pct m/m.

text.p: Eight economists polled by Reuters expected Norway's consumer price index to rise by an average 0.15 percent month-on-month in February and 3.15 percent year-on-year.
The range for the month-on-month estimate was between minus 0.1 to plus 0.3 percent. The range in the estimated rise from February 1996 to February 1997 was from 2.9 percent to 3.3 percent.
February inflation figures are due on March 10 at 0845 GMT.
Participating institutions: Chase Manhattan Bank, Christiania Markets, DnB Markets, Elcon Securities, Fondspartner, Handelsbanken, Orkla Finans, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken .
